work.math: $11.08 is the advertised base price for compute. Costs for the region, data sent out, disk and builds are unknown.
$0.1188 an hour for 730 hours = $86.724 for compute. Bandwidth (data transfer), disk, image, builds and logs are not included.
$86.724 is the known compute cost. PostgreSQL runs on the same server, but extra capacity, snapshots and the exact total are unknown.
